research_notes: Initial research2026-10-01: frozen official occupation list, indexed federal biography, state historical record, full2002and2015 inaugural speeches,2019 first-person farming account, ABC election profiles, party biography and historical hearing evidence. Roster unchanged.

Central classification gap: official Advertising and Public Administration1999–2002 contrasts with first-person advertising and public relations. No primary evidence names an ordinary public department. Preserve official wording and uncertainty rather than silently correct or manufacture a public-service period.

All early employer names and substantive hours remain unknown. Four occupations grouped to1999 cannot all receive1999 as actual termination date; individual fields left null, group limit retained in notes. Guiding1995–99 and advertising1999–2002 may overlap; no durations added.

First Senate speech explicitly records unemployment between jobs. Travel and study gaps also require dates. Occupation titles and manual work do not establish continuous full-time status. Unknown public and private totals, not zeros.

Searches targeted employer agency, public administration/public relations, Swiss gardening, Scottish farm, wilderness company and annual-report leads. No match identifying pre-parliament legal employers. Exploratory Clemenger and Tasmanian Expeditions searches did not establish employment and are not recorded as employers.

Facebook21February2019 nostalgia post https://www.facebook.com/NickMcKim/posts/fbf-to-my-days-as-a-wilderness-guide/10155858929847056/ returned Online fetch throttled; no retry. Snippet about three seasons may belong to a commenter and is not treated as his tenure. CDU biographical copy returned403. Lake Pedder hosted Senate-speech PDF returned500 non-retryable redirect; full OpenAustralia speech successfully recovered.

Follow up legitimate historic professional profile, guide-operator staff archives and Hobart agency records; resolve public-administration wording, campaign employment relationship, work/travel breaks and state resignation date. Existing public speeches exhaust broad career summaries; source-specific employer leads needed next.

Follow-up2026-10-02: contemporary state Integrity Commission annual report p5 explicitly states4August2015Assembly resignation. TEC4August vacancy release corroborates resignation by that date. Refined end day using agreement with state member history, retaining conflicting federal2August evidence.

Hobart agency/copywriter, guide-operator and employer-name searches found no person-specific legal employer identification beyond already retained ABC and parliamentary accounts. Advertising industry namesakes and McKim comments about later FontPR ownership do not identify his employer. Public-administration wording, seasons, employment/travel breaks and substantive hours remain unresolved. Next follow-up requires new historical staff/agency evidence; broad biographies exhausted.

Follow-up2026-10-04: targeted exact-name searches for Hobart advertising/copywriting, public relations versus public administration, wilderness-guide operators and plausible Tasmanian companies repeated the established occupation sequence but did not identify a legal employer, dates, seasons or substantive hours. Third-party profile copies merely repeat the frozen Parliamentary Handbook wording; they were not promoted as independent evidence. Seek historical staff directories, archived agency portfolios or guide payroll/staff records rather than repeating broad biographies.
